product.title: Eat, Drink, Cycle: Osaka Food and Bike Tour

description.text: In Osaka, this three-to-four-hour bike-and-food outing meets at the Cycle Osaka shop in Tenma, then rides past Osaka Castle Park between multiple food stops. A bicycle, English-speaking guide, lunch tastings, bottled water, and drinks are listed. Hotel pickup is not listed. The format suits visitors who want a guided ride-and-eat window without renting independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Osaka, and the itinerary stays on Tenma, Osaka Castle Park, and the published food stops that define this outing rather than a Dotonbori walking crawl.

start.description: Meet at the Cycle Osaka shop, 1-chome-10-7 Tenma, Kita Ward.

end.description: Return to your Osaka meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
